description: Hand-held camera shake (1.5 px RMS, 0.3-6 Hz, + 0.15 px tremor 8-12 Hz) over a pump with only a small 1x (0.12 px) at 24.67 Hz; 60 fps. Tests shake cancellation using the wall.
frame_time: t_i = i / fps is the centre of the exposure of frame i

conventions.part_displacement: true motion of the part relative to the static wall/world
conventions.observed_image_motion: part displacement + camera shake (shake moves the wall too)
conventions.phase: component = amp * cos(order * shaft_angle + phase); shaft_angle = 0 at t = 0
